name: @afora/otel
description: OpenTelemetry tracing for afora applications: a span per command, use case and repository call, nested as the calls are, with no input, response or sensitive value in any span.
author: Alan Reis <alanreisanjo@gmail.com> (https://github.com/Hoyasumii)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm --packages external --tsconfig-override tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun ../../scripts/add-dts-extensions.ts dist
